content:
The test image shows a split-open soybean pod with white, cottony fungal growth surrounding a small, discolored seed inside. This is classic White Mold — the fluffy white mycelium coating the interior of the pod and seed matches perfectly. The pod interior has the characteristic white, cottony appearance described in White Mold symptoms, and the seed is visibly shrunken/discolored beneath the mold.

The reference collage confirms White Mold features: white cottony growth on pods and stems with similar appearance.
